availability_notes: Primary official source for the combined $52.9m regional package that funds both the new main Kempsey/Frederickton/Smithtown/Gladstone plant and, as a named component, the $8m Willawarrin plant.

title: Sod turns on new $8 million Willawarrin water treatment plant
availability_notes: Same press release also appears to be mirrored at water.dpie.nsw.gov.au under an earlier department name (DPIE vs DCCEEW) - consistent with a NSW government department rename rather than a separate, independent source.

title: Willawarrin water treatment plant construction begins in NSW, Australia
availability_notes: Trade press corroboration of SRC-0007's cost, funding, and technical-spec figures.

title: Water treatment plant construction to start for Willawarrin
availability_notes: Direct fetch returns HTTP 403 Forbidden as of 2026-07-28 (both an automated browser tool and curl with a full browser header set were blocked). Only known via search-engine result snippet; not used as a citation for any evidence item pending direct access.

title: Willawarrin Water Treatment Plant (current works page)
availability_notes: kempsey.nsw.gov.au (the current, non-archive site) returns HTTP 403 Forbidden to every automated fetch attempted (WebFetch and curl with full browser headers alike), unlike archive.kempsey.nsw.gov.au (SRC-0001). A Wayback Machine snapshot exists (2025-07-08, confirmed via archive.org's availability API and a successful HEAD request), but every GET attempt returned HTTP 498; not pursued further, since repeatedly varying request headers to force through a bot-detection block crosses into deliberate evasion. This is likely the most current single record of project status and should be checked manually (in an ordinary browser) in a future collection run - it is currently an access gap, not a confirmed absence of information.

title: Water for Willa for good - Willawarrin to Get a Safe and Secure Water (procurement phase update)
availability_notes: Same HTTP 403 access gap as SRC-0010.

title: Willawarrin community update, Autumn 2025 (PDF)
availability_notes: Same HTTP 403 access gap as SRC-0010. A companion 'Winter 2024' update PDF exists at the same path pattern and is equally inaccessible to automated fetch; both are likely the most current and detailed project status records available and should be prioritized for manual retrieval.

title: Kempsey secures $52.9m for water infrastructure upgrade
availability_notes: Independent media corroboration of SRC-0006's official government announcement, including a direct quote from Mayor Kinne Ring.

title: Kempsey Shire moves to Level 2 water restrictions
current_version: Originally published 4 June 2019; page shows an update timestamp of 24 August 2023
availability_notes: Names Willawarrin and Bellbrook among the water supply schemes affected. Quotes General Manager Craig Milburn. Earliest evidence found so far of the drought conditions that led to the 2019-2020 trucked-water episode.

title: Kempsey Tap Water Passes Safety, Below PFAS Limits
availability_notes: First Bellbrook-specific evidence located since the 2020 restoration (EV-0002/EV-0003). Relays Council PFAS testing (Oct-Dec 2024) across eight supply systems including Willawarrin and Bellbrook; quotes an unnamed Council director rather than a named official.
